parameters.responseBody:
={{ ({
  success: Boolean($node["Course RAG Query"].json.answer),
  mode: "RAG_TUTOR",
  answer: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.answer || "Hệ thống tạm thời không nhận được câu trả lời từ AI Tutor. Vui lòng thử lại sau ít phút.",
  confidence: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.confidence || null,
  escalated: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.escalated || false,
  questionEscalationId: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.questionEscalationId || null,
  conversationId: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.conversationId || $node["Set - Trace Context"].json.conversationId,
  userMessageId: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.userMessageId || null,
  assistantMessageId: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.assistantMessageId || null,
  tutorSessionId: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.tutorSessionId || $node["Set - Trace Context"].json.tutorSessionId,
  sessionPhase: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.sessionPhase || $node["Set - Trace Context"].json.sessionPhase,
  subIntent: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.subIntent || $node["Intent Classifier"].json.subIntent || null,
  nextImproveSuggestions: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.nextImproveSuggestions || [],
  suggestedTopics: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.suggestedTopics || [],
  traceId: $node["Set - Trace Context"].json.traceId,
  sources: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.sources || [],
  sourceEvidence: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.sourceEvidence || [],
  groundingType: $node["Course RAG Query"].json.groundingType || "COURSE_MATERIAL"
}) }}

parameters.name: summary
parameters.value: =Student is practicing code in course {{$node["Set - Trace Context"].json.courseId}}

parameters.responseBody:
={{ ({
  success: Boolean($node["Code Mentor Query"].json.answer),
  mode: "CODE",

  escalated: false,

  userMessageId: $node["Code Mentor Query"].json.userMessageId || null,

  traceId: $node["Set - Trace Context"].json.traceId,

}) }}

parameters.jsonOutput:
=={{
  {
    traceId: $json.body.traceId || 'review-' + Date.now(),
    sessionId: $json.body.sessionId || '',
    conversationId: $json.body.conversationId || '',
    authToken: $json.body.authToken || (($json.headers.authorization || '').replace('Bearer ', '')) || '',
    studentId: $json.body.studentId,
    courseId: $json.body.courseId,
    classId: $json.body.classId || '',
    questionEscalationId: $json.body.questionEscalationId || '',

    reviewType: $json.body.reviewType || ((Number($json.body.rating) <= 3 || $json.body.accurate === false) ? 'ANSWER_DISPUTE' : 'QUALITY_FEEDBACK'),
    question: $json.body.question || '',
    answer: $json.body.answer || '',
    aiConfidence: $json.body.aiConfidence ?? '',
    rating: $json.body.rating,
    accurate: $json.body.accurate,
    helpful: $json.body.helpful,
    correctnessLevel: $json.body.correctnessLevel || '',
    feedback: $json.body.feedback || '',
    suggestedCorrection: $json.body.suggestedCorrection || '',
    reviewedBy: $json.body.reviewedBy || $json.body.studentId,
    reviewerRole: $json.body.reviewerRole || 'STUDENT'
  }
}}
